newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares firmer, PT, Sonae hit highs.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares firmer, PT, Sonae hit highs.

text.p: 1708 GMT - Portuguese shares closed higher, after both Portugal Telecom and industrial group Sonae Investimentos hit highs for 1996. Futures on the PSI-20 index closed well-supported. Dealers expected shares to push higher tomorrow as investors squared positions before year-end.

* Lisbon bourse suspended non-vote preference shares in construction company Soares da Costa after a sharp rise in the share price, dealers said. Bourse spokesmen were not immediately available to explain the suspension. Soares da Costa shares rose 32 percent to 2,320 escudos compared to the close on Friday.
